title: Articles to read
description: Send one or more articles: a title, a full article URL, or a lang:title line.

articles.title: Articles
articles.description: Articles: a title such as "Python (programming language)", a full URL such as https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Berlin, or a lang:title line such as de:Berlin.

lang.title: Default language
lang.description: Wikipedia language code used when the line carries none. Default en.

includeFullText.title: Include the whole article text
includeFullText.description: Return the full plain-text article instead of the lead section only. Off by default.

includePageviews.title: Include pageviews
includePageviews.description: Add the total and the daily series of views from the Wikimedia pageviews API. On by default.

includeCategories.title: Include categories
includeCategories.description: Add the visible categories of the article. On by default.

pageviewsDays.title: Pageviews window in days
pageviewsDays.description: How many days of views to sum. Default 30, maximum 365.

maxArticles.title: Maximum articles per run
maxArticles.description: How many lines of the list this run reads. Default and maximum 200; a line past the cap comes back as a free NOT_CHECKED_CAP row that names the cap.
